test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following elects the Vice President of India?

options.text: The members of the Parliament and State Legislatures
The elected members of the Parliament
Members of both houses of parliament
The members of the Rajya Sabha

solution:
The correct answer is __**Members of both houses of parliament.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Members of both Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha elect the Vice President of India**
 
• The Vice-President is chosen by an electoral college made up of representatives from both Houses of Parliament using a single transferable vote under the proportional representation system.
 
• **Voting in this election is conducted in secret.**
 
• All members of both Houses of Parliament make up the Electoral College, which chooses the Vice-President. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Vice-President is not a member of any state legislature or of either house of parliament. 
 
• If a member of either the House of Representatives or the House of the Legislature of any state is elected vice president, that member is assumed to have resigned from that House as of the day they take office.
 
• To become a Vice President:
 
 
• **A person should be a citizen of India. **
 
• **He has completed the age of 35 years**
 
• **He should be qualified for election as a member of the Council of the states.**
